final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_income_count FROM income i JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major GROUP BY m.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_income_count, 1.0 * member_income_count / SUM(member_income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), above_average AS (SELECT member_income_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(member_income_count) AS combined_count, AVG(average_share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
